Skills.Name: Corrosion
Skills.Description: Acid mastery. Acid-element spells deal +25% damage when the target is already Acidic. Open with AcidSpray or PoisonSpit, then stack acid spells for compounding damage. Synergizes with the acid_plus_organic material reaction.

Powers.Name: Etch
Powers.Description: +50% melee damage on Acidic targets, applied as bonus Acid damage. The acid weakens armor and flesh; your blade etches through the dissolved layer.

Powers.Name: Acid Retort
Powers.Description: When an attack on you misses, your caustic aura splashes the attacker — 3 Acid damage.

Powers.Name: Acid Spray
Powers.Description: A gout of acid: 1d4 acid damage in a line, range 4, etching the target (Acidic). Cooldown 10. Also taught by the Acid Spray grimoire.

Powers.Name: Caustic Trail
Powers.Description: Lay a visible acid film along 3 reachable cells. It lasts 4 turns, coating creatures that occupy or enter it with Acidic (0.35 corrosion), including allies. No immediate damage or collectible liquid. Cooldown 16; a wholly blocked lane is free.

Powers.Name: Caustic Draw
Powers.Description: Spend the Acidic coating on the first target in a line, range 4, for base Acid damage of 4 plus up to 8 from its corrosion. Trades away continued corrosion and Etch setup. Spell bonuses and resistance apply. Cooldown 20; a dry or empty first target is free. Requires Acid Spray.
